incidents.body:
UKMTO ADVISORY 127-26
UKMTO has received a report involving several merchant vessels in the Northern Arabian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman.
Reports indicate the vessels were subject to disabling fire as part of ongoing military activity in the region.
UKMTO is unable to confirm if any casualties or environmental impact has occurredat this time.
Authorities are aware and relevant investigations remain ongoing.
Mariners are advised to consider the latest maritime security information and maintain awareness of the evolving operational environment.

UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz.
UKMTO has received a verified report that a tanker was involved in a security incident resulting in two casualties. There is no report of environmental impact at this time.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO

UKMTO WARNING 124-26
Incident Date: 31 Aug 26 Incident Time: 2000UTC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 17NM east of Khasab, Oman.
A tanker has reported being struck by 3 unknown projectiles whilst completing an outbound transit of the Strait of Hormuz.
No casualties or environmental impact has been reported.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO ADVISORY 123-26
Incident Date: 30 Aug 26 Incident Time: 1624UTC
UKMTO have received a report of an incident involving a tanker and military forces in the Indian Ocean.
Vessels are advised to consider the latest maritime security information and maintain awareness of the evolving operational environment. Authorities are aware and relevant investigations remain ongoing.

UKMTO 122-26 - ATTACK
Incident Date: 29 Aug 2026 Incident Time: 2053UTC
UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 12NM north of Khasab, Oman.
A tanker has been struck by an unknown projectile whilst transiting inbound in the
Strait of Hormuz.
No casualties or environmental impact are reported at this time.

UKMTO ATTACK 121
UKMTO has received a report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz.
Local authorities have reported a tanker has been hit by an unknown projectile
causing fire to the vessel which has since been extinguished.
All crew are reported as safe and accounted for and there has been no report of
environmental impact.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to
UKMTO.

WARNING 120-26 UKMTO has received a report of an incident 9NM northeast of Ash Shishah, Oman.
The Master of an oil tanker reports the vessel has been struck by an unknown projectile causing damage to the engine room and disabling the vessel. Crew are reported safe. Environmental impact is unknown at time of report.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO. Authorities are investigating.

WARNING ATTACK 119
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 63NM west of Yanbu, Saudi Arabia.
The Company Security Officer reported a tanker has been struck by unknown
projectile causing a fire to the vessel on the main deck.
All crew are safe and accounted for and no environmental impact has been reported.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to
UKMTO.

UKMTO WARNING 118-26 - HIJACK
Incident Date: 20 Aug 2026 Incident Time: TBC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 136NM east of Al Mukalla, Yemen.
A tanker has broadcast a distress call on VHF 16 that they have been approached by an unauthorised vessel whilst travelling west in the Gulf of Aden.
Update 001 – UKMTO have received confirmation that the tanker has been boarded by six armed persons who are now in control of the vessel and redirecting to Somalia.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO 117-26 - ATTACK
Incident Date: 17 Aug 26 Incident Time: 1100UTC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 40NM southeast of Al Mukha, Yemen.
Local Authorities report a cargo ship being struck by multiple unknown projectiles.
The cargo vessel was unmanned at the time of the incident, however the damage has resulted in a complete constructive loss.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO has received a time late report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz.
A third party has reported that a bulk carrier was struck by an unknown projectile whilst conducting a transit of the Strait of Hormuz. The impact caused damage to the starboard side of
the vessel and resulted in a crew casualty.
There is no report of an environmental impact.
Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

18/08/2026 ATTACK:
UKMTO has received a report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz.
The Company Security Officer has reported that the vessel was struck by an unknown projectile
while conducting an outbound transit of the Strait of Hormuz. The impact caused damage to the
engine room and resulted in a crew casualty. The remaining crew are currently being assisted by
the Omani Coast Guard.
At present, no environmental impact has been reported.

UKMTO has received a report of an incident 4NM south of MAREEYO SOMALIA.
The CSO of a cargo vessel reports being boarded by 8 armed unauthorised persons who have taken control of the vessel.
Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report
any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO has received a report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz
UKMTO has received a verified report of a Bulk carrier being struck by an unknown
projectile which has hit the hull. The crew are reported safe, no damage assessment
has been reported and environmental impact is unknown at present.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to
UKMTO.

UKMTO has received a report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz.
UKMTO has received reports from Military Authorities that a tanker was struck by a Uncrewed Ariel Vehicle (UAV) whilst conducting an outbound transit of the Strait of Hormuz. The vessel was subject to minor damage, crew are reported as safe and accounted for and no environmental impact has been reported.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to
UKMTO.

UKMTO has received a report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz.
UKMTO has received reports from Military Authorities that a tanker was struck by a Uncrewed Ariel Vehicle (UAV) whilst conducting an outbound transit of the Strait of Hormuz. The vessel was subject to minor damage, crew are reported as safe and accounted for and no environmental impact has been reported.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to
UKMTO.

UKMTO WARNING 110-26 ATTACK
Incident Date: 11 Aug 26 Incident Time: TBC
UKMTO has been informed of an incident off the coast of Al Mokha, Yemen.
It has been reported that a cargo vessel in the Southern Red Sea has been hit by an unknown projectile resulting in casualties.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO ADVISORY 109-26
Incident Date: 11 Aug 26 Incident Time: 0715UTC
UKMTO have received a report of an incident involving a container ship and military forces in the Gulf of Oman.
Vessels are advised to consider the latest maritime security information and maintain awareness of the evolving operational environment. Authorities are aware and relevant investigations remain ongoing.

UKMTO WARNING 108-26 - ATTACK
Report Date: 08 Aug 2026
Report Time: TBC
Issue Date:08 Aug 2026
Source Verified
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 18NM east of Khasab, Oman.
A verified source has reported that a vessel was struck by an unknown projectile which caused a
fire that has been extinguished. There is no reported environmental impact. The vessel and crew
are reported as safe.
Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any
suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO has received a time late report of an incident 9NM southeast of Kumzar, Oman. The Master of a tanker has reported hearing two explosions whilst transiting in the Strait of Hormuz.
The report confirms that crew and vessel are safe. No environmental damage has been reported.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.
UPDATE 001: UKMTO ATTACK Warning 107-26 has been reclassified to ADVISORY 107-26. After a review determined the intended target could not be conclusively identified.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO WARNING 106-26 ATTACK Report Date: 05 Aug 26 Report Time: 1430UTC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 95NM southeast of Aden, Yemen.
The Master of a tanker reported hearing a loud explosion in close proximity to the
vessel. All crew accounted for and safe. There is no environmental impact reported.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to
UKMTO.

UKMTO WARNING 105-26 - ATTACK
Incident date: 04 Aug 2026. Incident time: 0730UTC
UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 9NM southwest of Al Mukha, Yemen.
The CSO of the vessel has reported that the vessel was attacked by an Uncrewed Surface Vessel which caused a fire onboard. The crew have been rescued by local authorities and are safe and well.
The vessel has been reported as sunk.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO while authorities are investigating.

UKMTO Warning 104-26 ATTACK
Incident Date: 03 Aug 26 Incident Time: 2200UTC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 20NM northeast of Al Khasab, Oman.
A cargo vessel has broadcasted on VHF 16 that they have been hit by an unknown
projectile.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to
UKMTO.

UKMTO ADVISORY 103-26 - ADVISORY
Report Date: 02 Aug 2026
Report Time:2037 UTC
Issue Date:02 Aug 2026
Source Master
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 20NM northeast of Khasab, Oman.
The Master of a tanker reports hearing an explosion in close proximity of the vessel. The vessel
and crew are all reported as safe.
Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any
suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO WARNING 102-26 ATTACK
Incident Date: 31 Jul 2026 Incident Time 2206UTC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 21NM northeast of Khasab, Oman.
The Master of a tanker reports seeing a large splash and explosion in close proximity to the vessel. No damage to the vessel has been reported at this time.
Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO WARNING 101-26 - ATTACK
Report Date:31 Jul 2026
Report Time: 2330UTC
Issue Date: 01 Aug 2026
Source Company Security
Officer
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 11NM northeast off Lima, Oman.
The CSO of a tanker reports the vessel has been struck by an unknown projectile
which has caused damage to the engine room. The tanker is not under command
and the regional Coast Guard have been informed.
There are no reported casualties or environmental impact.
Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report
any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO ADVISORY 098-26 - UKMTO has received a report of suspicious activity. The Master of a tanker has reported hearing an explosion whilst transiting in the southern Red Sea.
The report confirms that crew and vessel are safe. No environmental damage has been reported.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO ADVISORY 096-26 - UKMTO have received a report of an incident involving a tanker and military forces in the Gulf of Oman.
Vessels are advised to consider the latest maritime security information and maintain awareness of the evolving operational environment. Authorities are aware and relevant investigations remain ongoing.

UKMTO SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY 097-26 - UKMTO has received a report of an incident in the southern Red Sea.
It has been reported to UKMTO that a tanker witnessed a splash from an unknown
projectile in close proximity to the vessel. Reports confirm that the vessel and crew
are safe. Environmental impact is unconfirmed at present.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to
UKMTO while authorities continue to investigate

UKMTO ATTACK 095-26 - UKMTO has received a report of an incident 70NM southwest of AL SHUQAIQ, Saudi Arabia. The Master of a tanker reports being struck by an unknown projectile which has caused a fire
onboard that the crew are currently fighting. There are no reported casualties and no environmental impact.
Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO ATTACK 094-26 - UKMTO has received a report of an incident 8NM northeast of LIMAH, OMAN
UKMTO has received multiple reports that a tanker is reporting over VHF Channel 16
that it has been struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz.
UPDATE 001: The CSO of the tanker has reported to UKMTO that the crew have abandoned the
vessel and are currently embarked in a lifeboat.
No environmental impact has been reported.
Authorities are investigating.

UKMTO ATTACK 092-26 - UKMTO has received a report of an incident 8NM northwest of Kumzar, Oman.
UKMTO have received information from military authorities that a vessel is on fire. The cause of
the fire has not been verified as this time.
Update – 001 UKMTO has reclassified as an Attack. The CSO has confirmed the vessel was struck
by an unknown projectile. The crew safely abandoned the vessel and have been recovered by a
tug boat. The fire has not been extinguished and the vessel is currently adrift. There is no
reported environmental impact.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO while authorities investigate.

UKMTO WARNING 093-26 - ATTACK
Report Date:19 Jul 2026
Report Time: 2230UTC
Issue Date:20 Jul 2026
Source: Master
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 17NM east of Dibba, United Arab Emirates.
The Master of a vessel reports being struck by an unknown projectile causing damage to the
steering gear. All the crew are reported as safe. There is no environmental impact.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO

UKMTO ADVISORY 091 -26 - UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a merchant vessel and military
forces approximately 100NM east of Duqm, Oman.
Reports indicate that the tanker was subject to interaction as part of ongoing
military activity in the region.
Authorities are aware and relevant investigations remain ongoing.

UKMTO ADVISORY 089-26. Report Date: 15 Jul 2026
Issue Date: 17 Jul 2026
Source: Military authorities
UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a merchant vessel and military
forces in the Arabian Gulf.
Reports indicate that the tanker was subject to interactions as part of ongoing
military activity in the region.
Authorities are aware and relevant investigations remain ongoing.
Vessels are advised to consider the latest maritime security information and
maintain awareness of the evolving operational environment.

UKMTO HIJACK 090-26 - UKMTO has received a report of an incident 65NM south of Al Mukalla, Yemen.
Military authorities have reported that the vessel was boarded by unauthorised
personnel whilst transiting east in the Gulf of Aden.
Authorities are investigating.
UPDATE 001 – Military authorities have reported to UKMTO that the vessel involved has
been maneuvered into Somalian territorial waters. UKMTO has re-classified this incident
as Hijack

UKMTO WARNING 088-26. UKMTO has received a report of an incident 19NM east of Khasab, Oman.
A tanker has reported being hit by an unknown projectile causing minor structural
damage to the port side.
All crew are safe and accounted for, no environmental impact has been reported and
the vessel is continuing to its next port of call.
Authorities are investigating.

UKMTO WARNING 087-26
Incident Date: 13 Jul 2026 Incident Time: TBC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 13NM southeast of Limah, Oman.
A tanker has reported being hit by a missile while transiting outbound on the southern route.

UKMTO WARNING 086-26
Incident Date: 13 Jul 2026 Incident Time:TBC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 13NM southeast of Limah, Oman.
A tanker has reported being hit by a missile while transiting outbound on the southern route.

UKMTO WARNING 085-26 - ATTACK
Report Date: 13 Jul 2026
Report Time: 2104 UTC
Issue Date: 13 Jul 2026
Source: Master
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 40NM northeast of Qalhat, Oman.
The Master of a Tanker reports being hit by an unknown projectile on the starboard side engine
room. All crew are safe and accounted for with no environmental impact reported.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.
Authorities continue to investigate.

UKMTO WARNING 084-26 - SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY
Report Date:13 Jul 2026 Report Time:1019UTC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 50NM south of Aden, Yemen.
A tanker travelling east in the IRTC has reported being approached by 6 small boats
approaching from the starboard side. One small boat has closed to 5 cables and the
AST on board the tanker has fired warning shots. The other 5 small boats have
remained at 1NM.

UKMTO has received a report of an incident 9NM east of Oman.
Military authorities have reported that a container ship has sustained damage to the rear of the vessel which has caused a fire onboard.
Authorities are investigating.
UPDATE 001: UKMTO has been informed by military authorities and the CSO of the vessel that the crew have abandoned the vessel and are currently embarked in a lifeboat.
UPDATE 002: UKMTO has spoken to the CSO of the container ship who confirms that the crew has been rescued by local authorities.
Authorities continue to investigate.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO\_WARNING\_82-26. UKMTO has received a report of a further incident involving a tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz.
The tanker was struck by an unknown Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and has sustained minor structural damage. No casualties or environmental impact reported, and vessel is continuing to its next port of call.
UKMTO continues to investigate. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO\_WARNING\_81-26.
UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a tanker transiting the Strait of
Hormuz. The tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile and is believed to have
structural damage. No casualties or environmental impact reported.
UKMTO continues to investigate. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO WARNING 080-26 - ATTACK
Report Date: 06 Jul 2026 Report Time: 2119UTC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 8NM east of Limah, Oman.
A tanker has reported being hit by an unknown projectile on the port side causing a
fire, whilst travelling southbound.
No casualties or environmental impact reported.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to
UKMTO.

UKMTO WARNING 079-26 ATTACK
Report Date: 05 Jul 2026 Report Time: 0719UTC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 30NM southwest of Al Hudaydah, Yemen.
A cargo vessel has triggered a distress alert stating that they are under attack by unknown armed assailants.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO WARNING 078-26 - SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY
Report Date: 01 Jul 2026
Report Time:0945UTC
Issue Date: 01 Jul 2026
Source: Master
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 85NM south of Balhaf, Yemen.
The Master of a tanker had reported a small craft approached the vessel on the port
quarter at 2NM.
The small craft was described as having a low freeboard and orange interior with 4
POB. The small craft has now left the vicinity proceeding south. The crew are
reported as safe and the vessel is continuing on its voyage.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to
UKMTO.
